shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
PORT=4010
npm run dev -- --port $PORT >/tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
cleanup() { kill $PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
printf "--- /admin response ---'"\\n\"
curl -sSI \"http://127.0.0.1:"'$PORT/admin" | sed -n '"'1,20p'
printf \"\\n--- /admin body snippet ---\\n\"
curl -sS \"http://127.0.0.1:"'$PORT/admin" | sed -n '"'1,40p'
"
